title: tdd: inline the pass-in rule for dependencies
author: bendrucker
body:
The `tdd` skill kept its rule for substituting external dependencies in `references/mocking.md`. On `mock-boundary-weather` the session loaded the skill but never opened that reference, so it patched `globalThis.fetch` instead of giving `summary` a parameter. This states the rule in the skill body: substitute only what the process doesn't own, pass it in as a parameter, and reshape code that reaches a global before testing it.

Pre-registered target: `mock-boundary-weather` with arm, `no-global-patch` and `adapter-passed-in`, up from 0/2 at baseline. Guards: every other dev grader on the with arm.

| measure | row | baseline | candidate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Case score | mock-boundary-weather/with | 0.50 | 1.00* |
| Grader pass rate | mock-boundary-weather/with · adapter-passed-in | 0.00 | 1.00* |
| Grader pass rate | mock-boundary-weather/with · no-global-patch | 0.00 | 1.00* |
| Case score | mock-boundary-weather/without | 0.50 | 0.50 |

`*` marks p < 0.1 under `compare.ts`'s permutation test. The weather case pools 6 runs a side and the other dev cases 2. No guard row starred. `side-channel-users/with` dropped 0.88 to 0.75 unstarred. Its failing grader, `read-back`, also fails at baseline and is the next candidate's target.

Baseline runs: [35951967709](https://github.com/bendrucker/claude/actions/runs/35951967709), [35951975052](https://github.com/bendrucker/claude/actions/runs/35951975052), [35952908602](https://github.com/bendrucker/claude/actions/runs/35952908602), [35952914630](https://github.com/bendrucker/claude/actions/runs/35952914630).
